# Somos Reino Church

> Somos Reino ("We Are Kingdom") is a bilingual (Spanish and English) church family in Kissimmee, Florida. We gather for worship on Sundays at 11:00 AM and for discipleship on Wednesdays at 7:30 PM. Everyone is welcome; first-time visitors will be greeted at the door.

## Quick facts

- Name: Somos Reino Church (Spanish: Iglesia Somos Reino)
- Location: 2824 Michigan Ave Unit F, Kissimmee, FL 34744, USA
- Languages: Spanish and English (bilingual services)
- Sunday Celebration: Sundays, 11:00 AM. Worship, the Word and community, with kids ministry and coffee.
- Wednesday Discipleship (Formación): Wednesdays, 7:30 PM
- Somos Reino in Prayer: Mondays, 10:00 AM – 12:00 PM
- Email: hola@somosreino.org
- Podcast: Esencial · Principios del Reino (Kingdom Principles)

## Pages

- [Home](https://somosreino.org/): service times, location, what to expect, latest sermons and upcoming events

- [Events](https://somosreino.org/events): upcoming special events and weekly gatherings
- [Sermons](https://somosreino.org/sermons): recent messages, also on YouTube
- [Give](https://somosreino.org/give): online giving
- [Prayer request](https://somosreino.org/prayer): share a prayer request with the church
